decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a renamed, extended version of the established BASIC 518 trommel, so it builds directly on the firm's core screening knowledge, and the reported positive customer reception makes its results easy to read and act on.

The mobile flail shredders draw on the firm's long experience with mobile shredding and its service network, and they have a dedicated page, so the firm is well placed to assimilate feedback and refine them.

The high-speed grinder extends the firm's related mobile comminution know-how, but its only brief mention on the website suggests lower priority and leaves some risk that it is consolidated into the portfolio.

Stationary electric fine shredding is somewhat further from the firm's mobile core, and limited visibility makes the early results harder to interpret, though it fits the stated goal of resource-saving plant solutions.

The green-waste grinder fits the firm's composting and biomass customer knowledge, but it overlaps with Product C and gets only minimal web presence, raising the chance that the two are merged or one is pruned.
The single-shaft pre-shredders build on established shredder technology, are prominently presented, and support the move toward plant-based solutions for tougher processing requirements.
